campus_notes: ASU spans four metro-Phoenix campuses (Tempe, Downtown Phoenix, Polytechnic in Mesa, West Valley in Glendale); community addresses below identify the campus. ASU publishes no room dimensions, floor areas, or floor-plan drawings on its live housing site - only unit configurations, bed sizes, furnishings and rates. The only official room-size figures ever published were averages on now-removed move-in pages (captured via the Internet Archive): Taylor Place/Gordon Commons 214 sq ft and Casa de Oro 257 sq ft. Standard furnishings per resident (housing FAQ): bed, desk, desk chair, dresser, closet area, trash/recycle bins; all rooms have AC and most are carpeted. Beds are Twin XL 36" x 80" in nearly all communities (Gordon Commons lists 39" x 80"). Bed-size exceptions: Barrett's studio plan and the Willow 4-bedroom private-room/shared-bath plans use full-size beds (53" x 78"); Vista del Sol has full-size beds (54" x 75") for private-room bookings and standard twin (38" x 75") for shared-room bookings. Everything else is Twin XL. Rates shown are 2026-27 academic-year totals per person, room only.
